nodes.label: Results Feedback Loop (ad results -> bank statuses)
nodes.rationale: Closes the loop so winners compound and losers die: script frontmatter cites bank ids -> ad metrics (CPA, CTR, spend) append to manifest.json performance.results[] with a human verdict (scale|iterate|kill) -> prospector Mode 4 applies status transitions (untested->testing->proven/killed) with evidence in our_results -> next script batch queries proven entries first. Manual for now; automate if volume demands. Fatigue signal: frequency up + CTR down on a winner means pull the next untested hook from the same angle, don't kill the angle.
